checks.explanation: The selection disclosure is on page 1 and the itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices.
The basic services includes text lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only the Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as the overhead fee, with no second mandatory facilities or handling fee.
The embalming disclosure is on page 1 and the $795 embalming price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing.
The alternative container disclosure is on page 2 and the direct cremation range of $1,595 to $1,945 is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
The direct cremation section includes an option with container provided by the purchaser and does not state a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown to create an overlap or gap.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered good or service lacks its own line.
The list contains only itemized goods and required single-price items like forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial, with no optional combination package.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires purchase of any item; the embalming and container statements use the prescribed usually-not-required wording.
No text claims that a product delays decomposition long-term or protects the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and the required disclosures appear in clear full wording.
